features.text: Three-dimensional knit construction ensures optimal breathability and moisture management during activity
Contoured silicone patella donut provides targeted stabilization and tracking support
High-performance compression fabric delivers therapeutic warmth and promotes circulation
Athletic design allows full range of motion while maintaining professional-grade support
Lightweight, breathable material perfect for extended wear during sports and daily activities

measurement: For optimal compression and support, measure the circumference of your knee at the center of the patella. Visit our Perfect Fit Promise page for detailed sizing guidance and expert fitting assistance.
